preconditions: The campaign budget allows at least one more pair of runs
purpose: Propose one bounded group-journey/1 experiment likely to violate a journey invariant
steps: Read the verified findings and questions in this context
The participants are traveller-a and traveller-b, who are mandatory, and participant-c, who only views the itinerary
Pick one or more faults group-journey/1 supports, each with its parameters as name and value pairs
stale_preference_memory: preference_version (integer) is the superseded intent version, which is 1; after_event may be null
delayed_itinerary_update: delay_events (integer) is how many events late the update arrives, such as 2; after_event must be null

sharing_revoked_while_queued: recipient_id (string) is a participant, such as participant-c; after_event null revokes just after that recipient's message is queued, and a number revokes after that event
Pick one adapter of the pack: journey-naive or journey-version-checked
Set max_tool_calls to at most 20; the controller may state a lower limit in the context
Leave room for the adapter to finish: journey-naive needs at least 12 tool calls, or 16 with delayed_itinerary_update, and journey-version-checked needs at least 18
State the hypothesis and the invariant you expect to fail: commitments_use_approved_intent, mandatory_participants_feasible or delivered_messages_permitted
Return exactly one world_experiment_proposal object and nothing else
stop_conditions: No supported fault would test a new hypothesis
